card.name: Drug interaction tables with arrows
card.fires_on: Words and numbers inside pharmacokinetic interaction tables full of up/down arrows, such as 'to' in a confidence range, 'mg' after a dose, or '%' after a change. It also fires on the end of a drug name in these tables.

modes.label: Range 'to'
modes.description: The word 'to' between two arrow-marked numbers in a percent-change range.

modes.label: Dose units and changes
modes.description: 'mg', '%' or 'by' right after a dose or a change in exposure, next to arrows.

modes.label: Drug name ending
modes.description: The last piece of an antiretroviral drug name in a row of the table.
modes.example: obicistat darunavir: effect unknown ↑ amprenavir ↑ amprenavir ↓ indinavir ↓ etravir<<ine>> Co-administration of etravir

card.writes: It pushes toward odd symbol and special-character tokens and away from math symbols and arrows, so it adds little useful output.
card.plain: It marks spots in crowded drug-interaction tables where arrows, numbers and ranges are packed together.
